title: The Digital Humanities Dialogue for Students (2nd edition)
speaker: Weijie Huang (PhD, Media and Cultural Studies), Celis Tittse (PhD, Medieval History), Victor Elgersma (MA, History and Philosophy of Science)
location: University Library City Centre, room 0.21, Drift 27
description: Centre for Digital Humanities (CDH). Students and PhD researchers show how they have used digital methods in their own humanities projects, whether for a thesis, another project or a small assignment. For students who already use digital methods and for those who are just curious. Coffee and plenty of room for discussion. Free, but registration via the CDH website is required.
